newsitem.title: BOSNIA: NATO destroys contraband Croat police ammunition.
newsitem.headline: NATO destroys contraband Croat police ammunition.

text.p: The NATO-led peace force said on Saturday it was destroying illegal ammunition found at a Bosnian Croat civilian police station in central Bosnia.

Stabilisation Force (SFOR) troops confiscated 458 grenades at a police station in Vitez on Friday, after the ammunition was discovered by the United Nation police, NATO spokesman Major Tony White told reporters.
"The first 144 grenades have already been destroyed and the remainder will be destroyed today," he said.
NATO troops in Bosnia are mandated to enforce peacetime rules which limit weaponry held by former warring factions and civilian police forces.
NATO on Friday also removed an illegal Serb police checkpoint in the area separating the Moslem-Croat federation and the Bosnian Serb republic near the town of Jajce, White said.
